description_en: Clears the memory of a specified agent instance
description_zh: 清空指定 Agent 实例的记忆
name: ClearAgentInstanceMemory

parameters.help_en: The ID of the agent instance whose memory you want to clear. This parameter is required and can be obtained from the response of ListAgentInstanceMemory
parameters.help_zh: 要清空记忆的 Agent 实例 ID。服务端要求提供，可从 ListAgentInstanceMemory 返回结果获取
parameters.name: agent_instance_id

schema.description_en: The response of this API call
schema.description_zh: 本次 API 调用的响应结果

RequestId.description_en: The unique identifier of the request, which can be used for troubleshooting
RequestId.description_zh: 本次请求的唯一标识，可用于排查问题
